title.en: History of Chalcolithic Age vs Bronze Age (Indus Valley Civilization)
title.hi: History of ताम्रपाषाण काल Age vs Bronze Age (Indus Valley Civilization)

rows.en: Predominantly copper with stone; bronze rare
rows.hi: Predominantly copper with stone; bronze rare

title.en: Similarities between Chalcolithic Cultures and Early Farming Communities
title.hi: Similarities between ताम्रपाषाण काल Cultures and Early Farming Communities

rows.en: Both relied on agriculture, animal domestication, and hunting-gathering.
rows.hi: Both relied on agriculture, animal domestication, and hunting-gathering.

rows.en: Both made extensive use of microliths and polished stone tools.
rows.hi: Both made extensive use of microliths and polished stone tools.

clarification.en: While both used stone tools, the Chalcolithic Age is marked by the first use of copper alongside stone, whereas the Neolithic Age is strictly aceramic/ceramic stone-using without metallurgy.
clarification.hi: While both used stone tools, the ताम्रपाषाण काल Age is marked by the first use of copper alongside stone, whereas the नवपाषाण काल Age is strictly aceramic/ceramic stone-using without metallurgy.

relationship.en: Excavated sites provide organic samples utilized in radiocarbon dating to establish the chronology of the Chalcolithic period.
relationship.hi: Excavated sites provide organic samples utilized in radiocarbon dating to establish the chronology of the ताम्रपाषाण काल period.
